## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, what changes for the user or agent, and why this approach fits.

Link the issues addressed (use `Closes #...` only when fully resolved).

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Include a small fixture or trace when changing language analysis, graph retrieval, or token accounting. Separate response bytes, token estimates, and model-reported usage.

For evaluation changes, record the question, source revision, graph coverage, checked relationship precision, budgets, and truncation; distinguish these from answer completeness. For template changes, validate YAML and required fields. Mark checks not run explicitly.

Link only public, reviewed, redacted artifacts. Keep private source, repository graphs or indexes, and raw private traces out of the PR and its attachments.

## Compatibility and gaps

Note installation, output-contract, or index changes and known verification gaps. Link updated documentation when behavior changes.
